connector.name: Pushary
connector.registryDescription: Notify me when my agent needs me: approve from my phone, answer questions away from the terminal.
connector.summary: Hosted at pushary.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the pushary account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
